description: Versioned mapping specification: SDR physical telemetry → RescueOS Advisor observation schema (phase5-ood-case-v1).

rssi_dbm.source: RTL-SDR driver RSSI register or GNU Radio power measurement block

snr_db.source: Computed as RSSI - noise_floor in the GNU Radio telemetry collector

ber.source: Frame-level CRC error count / total bits in window
ber.missing_policy: null — use packet_loss_rate; if both null, noise=0.0

packet_loss_rate.source: Sequence-number gap analysis in GNU Radio telemetry collector
packet_loss_rate.missing_policy: null — use ber; if both null, noise=0.0

source_timestamp_utc.description: UTC datetime at which the receiver hardware produced this measurement
source_timestamp_utc.source: GNU Radio wall-clock tag or SDR sample-counter converted to UTC

ingestion_timestamp_utc.description: UTC datetime at which the harness wrote this record to its buffer
ingestion_timestamp_utc.source: Harness process wall-clock at record receipt

window_duration_s.source: GNU Radio block configuration; must match protocol

is_valid.description: True if all fields are within expected operating range and no driver fault was flagged

is_stale.description: True if the source flagged this record as stale before delivery

is_malformed.description: True if framing errors, CRC failures, or missing mandatory fields were detected

rssi_baseline_dbm.description: RSSI measured at 0 dB attenuation during warm-up. MUST be determined empirically on the physical bench and recorded in the protocol before any test trial begins.

rssi_noise_floor_dbm.description: Receiver noise floor. MUST be taken from the manufacturer datasheet for the exact RTL-SDR hardware revision and frequency in use. Do not use a generic value.
rssi_noise_floor_dbm.note: RTL-SDR v3 at 433 MHz with default LNA gain: approximately -100 to -105 dBm (verify from datasheet)

min_window_duration_s.description: Minimum observation window for evidence to be considered sufficient

ambiguous_snr_low_db.description: Lower bound of the ambiguous SNR band (inclusive). Records in this band set evidence_initially_insufficient=true.

ambiguous_snr_high_db.description: Upper bound of the ambiguous SNR band (inclusive).

max_staleness_s.description: Maximum permitted lag between source and ingestion timestamps

family.description: Three-fault causal chain (path-loss → SNR degradation → packet loss). V4 when packet_loss_rate > 0.30 and severity_raw < 0.10 (unexplained packet loss).
family.V3_condition: default for all valid, non-unknown-fault observations
family.V4_condition: packet_loss_rate > 0.30 AND severity_raw < 0.10 AND NOT evidence_initially_insufficient

mechanism_id.description: SDR RF path loss mechanism. Not a benchmark pool identifier.

composition_id.description: FG=RF path (Gate), FW=SNR/link quality (Witness), FJ=packet threshold (Jurisdiction)

relation_type.description: Attenuation and noise sources are physically separable in the coaxial bench.

criterion.PI1: Receiver sensitivity / path loss (binding when severity >= noise*2)
criterion.PI2: SNR / link quality (binding when neither severity nor noise dominates)
criterion.PI3: Packet-loss rate / application reliability (binding when noise > severity)
criterion.selection_rule: PI1 if severity >= 2*noise, PI3 if noise > severity, PI2 otherwise

severity.note: Rounded to nearest discrete value; ties go to higher value

noise.note: Takes maximum of available error indicators; clamped at 0.20 (max discrete level)

evidence_initially_insufficient.condition: snr_db in [ambiguous_snr_low_db, ambiguous_snr_high_db] OR window_duration_s < min_window_duration_s

required_actions.description: Action sequence required for recovery, derived from severity band

rejection_policy.malformed_record: Reject; observation_json=null; do not submit to Advisor
rejection_policy.rejected_record_audit_entry: Always write an audit record with mapping_result=rejection_reason; advisor_action_sequence=null; decision_sha256=null

stale_policy.definition: A record is stale if is_stale=true OR (ingestion_timestamp_utc - source_timestamp_utc) > max_staleness_s
stale_policy.treatment: Reject; do not map or submit to Advisor
stale_policy.missing_data_contribution: Counts as missing; applied toward missing_data threshold in protocol

contradictory_value_policy.definition: A record is contradictory if packet_loss_rate > 0.30 AND severity_raw < 0.10 (severe packet loss without path loss explanation)
contradictory_value_policy.treatment: Map to V4 (unknown_fault=true) rather than reject; submit to Advisor for abstention or evidence-request recommendation

one_way_constraint.description: This mapping layer is strictly one-way: telemetry IN, observation OUT. No Advisor output flows back through this layer to any transmitter interface.
one_way_constraint.prohibited: Any modification to the mapping that creates a feedback path from Advisor output to transmitter configuration

protocol_freeze_requirement: All mapping_parameters must be fixed and recorded in the physical-test protocol before any bench trial begins. Changing parameters after observing Advisor outputs is a protocol violation.
